footer.brand_desc: A Parisian accessories house, crafted in small batches from materials selected with rigour.

hero.sub: Dense black knit, tonal Uroko pattern. The SAINT beanie opens the house, one piece at a time.

story.p1: SAINT was born of a clear intention: to take the time to design pieces that mean something, free from the constant acceleration of trends. We see accessories not as add-ons, but as objects of expression in their own right.
story.p2: Inspired by the clean lines of contemporary design and the rigour of Japanese aesthetics, our approach favours the relief of the material, the precision of the cut and an uncompromising attention to detail. From the curve of the knit to the engraved medallion, every element is designed to stand the test of time and blend naturally into everyday dress.
story.p3: Create with intention, build with patience, give weight to what lasts.

uroko.label: The pattern
uroko.title: Uroko, the scale that protects
uroko.p1: In traditional Japanese textiles, the Uroko pattern dressed armour and kimonos as a symbol of protection and renewal. SAINT translates it directly into the knit, tone on tone, so it only reveals itself to a lingering eye.
uroko.p2: The pattern also draws on seigaiha, the ancestral Japanese wave motif symbolising calm and good fortune, and on the shape of the SAINT fan, found engraved on every medallion.

materials.intro: A deliberately limited number of fibres, chosen for how they hold up over time rather than for their cost.
materials.mat1_desc: Light, thermoregulating, chosen for how it holds up over time. The Éventail beanie's main fibre.
materials.mat2_desc: Reinforces the knit without weighing it down. Keeps its shape after dozens of washes.
materials.mat3_desc: SAINT-signed medallion, pressed and laser-engraved. Develops a natural patina with wear.

faq.a1: Each piece is crafted with particular care, in small series, from materials chosen for how they hold up over time.
faq.a2: Yes. Each series is produced in a deliberately restricted quantity, to preserve its exceptional character.

faq.q5: How do I care for my beanie?
faq.a5: Hand washing in cold water, without wringing, preserves the shape and the material. Avoid the washing machine and the tumble dryer.
